network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti identificano l'incidente al ponte sull'Orzanella durante l'alluvione del 13 novembre 2000, ma non pubblicano livello, portata, stazione o idrogramma del torrente. La cronaca giudiziaria non viene usata per inferire una misura.
network_status.summary_en: The sources identify the incident at the Orzanella bridge during the flood of 13 November 2000 but publish no stream stage, discharge, station or hydrograph. The judicial account is not used to infer a measurement.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
